film_facts.title: Practical Magic 2
film_facts.critics_consensus: Nostalgic and inert, Practical Magic 2 has charms thanks to Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman's sisterly rapport, but its mechanical plotting is a whole lot of toil that's not worth the trouble.
film_facts.critics_overview: Despite its moderate production and marketing costs, Variety wrongly estimated the film would lose Warner Bros. Nikki Gemmell of The Australian gave it a three-out-of-five review and wrote, "Fans will still be fans.
